full_prompt_en: A square close-up image shows a hand holding a sharpened dark pencil against an intensely detailed black-and-white drawing of part of a human face. The drawing fills the whole background, cropped so that one large eye sits near the center-right and the broad nose reaches into the lower left. The eye has a bright small catchlight, a sharply detailed iris, dark upper lashes, and a heavy brow above it. Beneath the eye, the cheek is built from dense tiny scratches, hatch lines, speckles, and pale marks cut into a dark ground. These marks change direction across the nose bridge and around the nostril, making the drawn form appear rounded despite the highly graphic surface. From the right edge, a real warm-toned hand enters with thumb and fingertips visible, gripping the pencil close to its point. The pencil tip touches a small area just below the eye, suggesting an active finishing stroke rather than a posed still life. Its black barrel crosses diagonally from the right toward the center, creating a strong smooth line against the intricate grain. The hand is the only colored element, with natural peach skin contrasting against the otherwise monochrome artwork. The frame is so tight that the full face, wrist, and drawing surface edge remain outside view. Even light falls across the hand and drawn page, revealing the raised-looking texture of the marks without deep cast shadow. The overall composition is tactile and focused, joining the precise drawn gaze to the physical act of making it.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形近景图像呈现一只手握尖头深色铅笔，贴近一幅细节极密的黑白人脸局部绘图。绘图填满背景，裁切后，一只大眼位于中央偏右，宽鼻伸入左下。眼睛有一小点明亮反光、刻画清楚的虹膜、深色上睫毛和上方浓眉。眼下的面颊由密集细刮痕、排线、斑点及刻入暗底的浅色标记构成。这些线痕在鼻梁和鼻孔周围改变方向，使高度图形化的表面仍显圆润体积。右边缘一只真实、带暖色肤调的手伸入，拇指和指尖可见，靠近笔尖握住铅笔。笔尖触到眼下的一小块区域，像正在完成一笔，而非摆设静物。黑色笔杆从右侧斜穿向中央，在繁密颗粒前形成一道强而平滑的线。手是唯一有色彩的部分，自然桃色皮肤与其余单色作品对照。画框极紧，以致完整面孔、手腕和绘图纸边都在画外。均匀光照在手和绘图上，揭示笔痕仿佛凸起的肌理，却没有浓重投影。整体构图可触且聚焦，把精确绘出的目光与实际制作动作连接。
style_prompt_en: The image has a scraperboard-like monochrome drawing finish, built from thousands of tiny light scratches, stipples, and crosshatched marks over a dark field. Mark density changes gradually to model volume, while occasional crisp highlights sharpen the focal area. Curved and straight hatching follow different planes, giving the surface a worked, hand-made rhythm rather than a uniform digital grain. A smooth diagonal dark element can interrupt the dense texture and make the contrast especially legible. Even light exposes the minute marks without broad glossy glare. The overall effect is painstaking, tactile, and high contrast, with form emerging from the spacing and direction of small incisions.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有刮版画般的单色绘图质感，由成千上万的细浅刮痕、点纹和交叉排线覆盖深色底域。笔痕密度渐变以塑造体积，少量锐亮部则收紧焦点。弯直不同的排线沿各平面走向变化，使表面有反复加工的手作节奏，而非均匀数字颗粒。一道平滑斜向暗形可以打断密集肌理，使反差格外清晰。均匀光显露细微笔痕，没有宽阔耀眼的光泽。整体效果精细、可触且高反差，形体从小刻痕的间距和方向中浮现。
theme_en: A hand holding a pencil beside a highly textured monochrome drawing of an eye and nose
theme_zh: 一只手持铅笔靠近细密单色眼鼻绘图
name: Scraperboard art
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
